data.title: Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Meets with Türkiye's Minister of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change
data.content:
Antalya, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman bin Abdulaziz met with Minister of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change of the Republic of Türkiye Murat Kurum on the sidelines of the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye.
    The two ministers explored ways to strengthen cooperation on climate action, reviewed developments at COP31 and discussed efforts to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement in a manner that takes into account countries’ national circumstances and contributes to balanced and inclusive outcomes.
    -- SPA
